WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind, f.sales_line_id AS id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, 'ret', r.return_line_id
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales END) AS sales, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ret' THEN net_sales END) AS rets, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT id||kind) nd
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT business_date, store_id, receipts, net_sales_before_returns, returns_net, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' ORDER BY 1;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) keys, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullchan, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net

FROM net_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
